messages:
Sam (sales): Flagging SolaceHealth POC next week. They want a 48h smoke + throughput run. Need reserved GPU preheat checklist, autoscale JSON for ops, and security QA answers.
Nora (solutions): Quick: what's their peak/steady profile and typical token lengths?
Sam (sales): Peak bursts ~210 qps for 2-5m, steady ~55 qps. Avg response ~95 tokens. Minimal embeddings.
Vik (infra): Recommend reserved 5 GPUs, burst credits for +4 GPUs up to 3m, autoscale to 11 if sustained. Trigger on queued_requests and p95_latency.
Kai (sre): Use burst credits for short spikes to avoid cold starts; fallback to autoscale after 180s. I'll add an eviction tolerance note for spot fallback.
Asha (security): For Qs: we support Dedicated VPC peering or private deployment, customer-managed KMS, SOC2 Type II, console IP allowlist, and SSO. Send their questionnaire and Ill draft answers by EOD.
Nora (solutions): Quant note: redwood-14b-q8 usually gives ~+25% throughput; call out possible +1 GPU to preserve p95 in certain kernels. We can offer a quant committed discount on reserved SKUs.
Vik (infra): Preheat checklist snippet: 1) deploy canary model to reserved pool; 2) seed top-50 prompts into KV cache; 3) run synthetic warmer at 10 qps for 10m; 4) verify kv_cache_hit_rate >= 60% and p95 latency targets; 5) if p95 > target -> add 1 GPU.
Sam (sales): Can someone paste the autoscale JSON to hand to their ops team?
Vik (infra): {"autoscale": {"min_reserved": 5, "max_reserved": 11, "scale_step_secs": 30, "burst_credit_threshold_secs": 180, "metrics": ["queued_requests", "p95_latency"]}}
ScheduleBot: Scheduled solace_poc_smoke for 2026-05-04T16:00:00Z. Report will be posted in this thread. :robot_face:
Nora (solutions): I'll deliver a 1-pager sizing rationale, preheat runbook, pricing delta table (quant vs baseline), and a filled security checklist draft by EOD. Sam, ping legal when Asha posts the security answers.
Sam (sales): Great, thanks everyone.
